newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr-Sept electricity demand up 2.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr-Sept electricity demand up 2.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's electricity demand in the first half of the 1996/97 business year rose 2.5 percent from the same period a year earlier to 385.9 billion kilowatt hours, an industry body said on Friday.

The Federation of Electricity Power Companies, which groups Japan's key nine electricity utilities, said usage of air conditioners during the April to September period was down from the year-earlier period which saw extremely high temperatures.
However, commercial demand from businesses increased, the body said.
Large-lot industrial demand rose by 1.6 percent in the first half from a year earlier, which means a year-on-year increase for the fifth consecutive term, the body said.
A sharp increase in demand from paper mills and firm demand from machinery makers outweighed a fall in consumption by steel makers, it said.
